subject: general
question: Which of the following refers to protection of data against accidental or intentional disclosure to unauthorised persons or unauthorised modification or destruction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Data Security**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Data Security** refers to the protection of data against accidental or intentional disclosure to unauthorized persons or unauthorized modification or destruction.
 
• It involves implementing measures such as encryption, access controls, and secure storage to safeguard data integrity and confidentiality.
 
• Ensuring data security is crucial for maintaining trust and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
 
• Data Security is a fundamental aspect of information security, which aims to protect sensitive information from breaches and cyber threats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Encryption** is one of the key techniques used in data security to transform readable data into an unreadable format for unauthorized users.
 
• **Access controls** ensure that only authorized individuals can access or modify data, based on their roles and permissions.
 
• **Data redundancy** involves storing multiple copies of data to prevent loss in case of hardware failure or other issues.
 
• Organizations must regularly update their **security policies** and practices to address emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
 
• Data security is not only a technical challenge but also involves **user education** and awareness to prevent social engineering attacks and other security breaches.
